Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game. Papua New Guinea are going to the T20 World Cup next year in Australia as they remain on top after this game. Now, before the playoffs take place, we have the final game of the group stage where the  hosts UAE will take on Canada. Do join us for that game. Till then, take care!

Kyle Coetzer, the Scotland skipper says that the wicket is always going to be challenging. They needed to put on runs which was defendable and that was not the case. On good start in the Powerplay, Coetzer says that they were not disciplined with the ball. He says that they got wickets in the middle but credits Ryan for his brilliant innings. For the next phase of the tournament, the Scott skipper feels that they will keep believing in themselves and they will work hard. On PNG qualifying, Coetzer says that they are hard working side and they deserve to be on top of the table. Coetzer  wishes PNG a lot of luck.

Pieter Seelaar, the Netherlands' skipper is  MAN OF THE MATCH for his superb bowling performance. He says that they wanted to win the match in that 12.3 overs range but a win is always pleasing. Winning 5 out of 6 games is a good result overall states Seelaar. On the surface, the Dutch skipper mentions that because of the hot conditions, the wicket slowed down. On their tactics during the middle over, Seelaar points that they took the pace off the ball and made the batsman use more power to score the runs. Adds that their bowling was outstanding but the batting was not as free flowing as they wanted it to be. On the side's goal, Seelaar says that they wanted to stay unbeaten in this first phase of the tournament but that is not the case. Credits PNG for the superb cricket and adds that they have been the best fielding side of the tournament. Hopes that the pitches will be fresh for the next phase of the tournament which will assist the batters a bit.

Earlier in the day, the Netherlands bowling is what set the victory up for them. Despite Cross' 50, Scotland could only manage an average score. All the bowlers chipped in with a wicket at least and played a big part in the win.

An easy run chase in the end for Netherlands but they still do not get direct qualification for the T20I World Cup. They needed to chase this down within 12.3 overs, they did come out with that intent but lost early wickets. At one point, they were in a spot of bother when they were 31 for 3. However, Ryan ten Doeschate and Ackermann steadied the ship well and once they got in, they started taking the attack to the bowler. When the two were batting, the hopes of chasing this down within 12.3 overs were ignited but then, wickets in quick succession saw that get out of reach. In the end though, they would be happy with the fact that they finished over the line.
Shortish ball around off, ten Doeschate taps it towards point to take a run. NETHERLANDS WIN BY 4 WICKETS.
On middle this time, Edwards sweeps it towards fine leg and takes a single. The scores are level now.
Around off, ten Doeschate guides it behind point to take a single and reach his half century, his third in T20Is. Top knock this one.
On middle, ten Doeschate looks to paddle it fine but misses to get hit on the pads.

Full ball on off, ten Doeschate drives it through cover point. He completes the single and wants the second too. He takes off for the second and completes the run by diving inside his crease. Moves to 49.
Quicker one outside off, ten Doeschate taps it through point for a couple now. It has been a very good innings this one from him.
Full ball on middle, Edwards drives it through mid on and scampers back for the second. Netherlands are showing no hurry here. 7 more needed.
Back of a length ball on middle, ten Doeschate pulls it for a single towards deep mid-wicket.
Yorker now! Ten Doeschate does well to dig it out, back to the bowler.

Shortish length ball on middle, Edwards looks to turn it around but gets an inside edge onto the body. The ball goes towards empty slip cordon. A quick single taken as Cross, the keeper hares at the ball.
Length ball on the pads, ten Doeschate tucks it towards fine leg for a single. He wanted the second but decides against it.
Bouncer on middle, Edwards goes for the pull but ball hits the splice and goes behind square. Just a single there.
Safyaan Sharif to bowl no. 2-0-15-1 are his figures so far.
Length and on off, Edwards works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Shorter one on middle, Ryan pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
Length and on off, Ryan lofts it straight over the bowler's head to long off for a couple.
Good length delivery outside off, Edwards drives it through covers for a single.
Length and outside off, Edwards flicks it to mid-wicket for a couple.
Length and on off, pushes it to covers for single.
Outside off this time, Edwards looks to heave it away but the slowness of the ball does him in. Can't get any bat on the ball.
Full toss on the pads, flicked off the toes this time by Edwards for a couple this time.
Alasdair Evans comes back on. 3-0-26-1 are his figures so far.
On middle this time, worked towards fine leg for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
Landed on middle, Seelar flicks it for a single towards deep mid-wicket.
Shortish length ball on middle, Edwards looks to pull but gets at top edge. The ball goes towards short third man and a single is taken.
Josh Davey is back to bowl. 2-0-15-1 are his figures so far.
Around middle, Edwards eases it through mid on for a single.
On the pads this time, Seelaar tickles it fine for a single towards fine leg.
Shortish ball around off, tapped through point for a single.
Scott Edwards is the next man in.

OUT! Stumped! Guess what, it is PNG who are pumped more than the Scotts. Why? Because they are going to Australia for sure to play the T20 World Cup. A ball around off, ten Doeschate looks to slam it over long on but the ball turns away a hint to miss the bat. Cross behind the wicket pouches the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. He appeals and the umpire agrees.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fuller ball outside off, driven towards sweeper cover for a couple.
Around off, Seelaar tucks it towards deep mid-wicket and hares back for a couple. So, PNG are going Australia for sure?
Short again, eased for a single through mid on.
Short around middle, Seelaar pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Shortish length ball this time, ten Doeschate punches it towards point for a single.
Fires this outside off, ten Doeschate leaves it alone, hoping that the umpire will call it wide but the ball is inside the tramline there.
On middle, pushed through mid on for a couple.
Calum MacLeod comes onto bowl.
Shortish length around off, seelaar takes a single and keeps the strike by tapping the ball through point.
On middle, ten Doeschate tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
Pieter Seelaar the skipper walks out next to bat.

OUT! Van der Merwe is out of here now! Full ball on middle, van der Merwe comes down the track to deposit the ball over the deep mid-wicket fence but can only hit the ball into  the hands of MacLeod at deep mid-wicket. Easy catch there for him. Can the Scotts turns this game around?
On off, van der Merwe pushes it back to the bowler.
The batsman dances down the track and does well to block the ball.
Roelof van der Merwe is the new man in.

OUT! Timber! Watt strikes! Ackermann is in search of quick runs. Watt bowls a ball slower through the air around off and middle, Ackermann looks to slog it away but misses to get any bat on ball. The ball goes behind and shatters the woodwork behind. PNG players in the stands are happy seeing this.
Mark Watt comes back on. His figures so far read 1-0-4-0.
The batsman has driven it through mid-on. One run added to the total.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Innovative shot that one. Full length ball around off and middle, Ackermann gets in position and scoops it over the keeper's head and into the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Superb batting this from Ackermann. Shortish length ball on middle, Berrington pulls it nicely and gets a boundary this time.
Ten Doeschate is expecting short ball as he back away. But this time the bowler fires a good length ball outside off, ten Doeschate pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Shortish length ball outside off, Ackermann drags the ball towards deep mid-wicket with a pull for a single.

SIX! Ackermann is into the action now! Netherlands are dealing in sixes at the moment. They are still eying that position at the top of the table. A full ball outside off, Ackermann lofts it way over the long off fence. The ball is lost in the stands now.
Length and on the pads, Ryan flicks it to mid-wicket for a couple. 18 runs from it. A Massive one for the Netherlands.
SIX! Second one of the over. ten Doeschate has shown here that experience counts. He pulls this shorter one iver mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, ten Doeschate drives it through covers for a couple.
Good length ball on middle, Ackermann flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Length and on off, rayan pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Excellent hit. Evans bowls a fuller one on Ryan's pads, he just flicks it up and over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
Alasdair Evans comes back on. 1-0-8-0 are his figures so far.
Flatter and on middle, this is kept out.
Shorter and on the body, Ackermann pulls it through backward square leg for a two.

Ryan comes down the track and the bowler shortens his length. He looks to defend but the ball hits the pad and rolls towards cover. An appeal but there is no chance for the umpire to give that. A leg bye was taken.
This is swept through square leg for one.
This is flatter and on off, it is pushed to covers for one.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped to the man at covers.
Mark Watt comes onto bowl.
Another shortish length ball. This time Berrington takes the pace off the ball. ten Doeschate pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Short ball around off, ten Doeschate pulls it to deep mid-wicket fence this time.
Short ball around off, punched off the back foot for a single.
Around off and middle, ten Doeschate tucks it behind square for a single.

FOUR LEG BYES! Berrington looks to bowl a full ball but misses his line just a hint. He bowls it on the pads, Ryan looks to tickle but misses to get hit on the shoes. The ball then goes to the fine leg fence.
Good length ball outside off, ten Doeschate drives it straight to point.
Richie Berrington comes onto bowl now.
Landed on middle and leg, flicked for a single towards deep square leg for a run now.
FOUR! Hammered away! Short ball on middle, ten Doeschate positions himself well and plays the pull shot to perfection. The ball races to the fence.
WIDE! Davey bowls a bumper but the line is down the leg side. Ten Doeschate leaves it alone and the umpire calls it wide.
Short ball outside off, ten Doeschate this time drives it well through cover-point
Around off, ten Doeschate defends it out.
Ryan ten Doeschate is the next man in.

OUT! Davey strikes now! Chances of Netherlands making the top of the table looks very bleak with wickets tumbling like this. This time Cooper is the man who departs. Davey bowls a length ball outside off, Cooper reaches out to drive but gets a thick outside edge and goes straight into the mitts of the keeper. Cross behind the wicket does not make any mistake.
Length ball around off, Cooper looks to drives it uppishly, the ball goes straight to the mid off fielder on the bounce.
Josh Davey comes back on. His figures read 1-0-7-0 so far.
Beaten! Super slower one this one. It is on a length around off, Ackermann pushes but is beaten. Lucky not to edge on that one.
On middle, Cooper this time works it behind square for a single.

SIX! First one of the innings and Cooper needs to hit a few of those if he wants to take his side on the top of the table. He gets a full ball in the slot. Cooper clears his front leg and lofts it over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
Beaten this time! A shortish length ball closer to the body. Cooper looks to drive but misses to get any bat on ball.
FOUR! Lovely timing on that one. A good length ball on middle, Cooper goes just a hint back to make room and cream the cover drive. The ball races to the fence in a jiffy.
WIDE! Shortish ball outside off. Cooper lets it go to the keeper. Called wide by the umpire for height.
Around off, Cooper looks to drive through mid off but manages the shot off the inner half of the blade towards short mid-wicket.
Safyaan Sharif comes back on. His figures read 1-0-3-1.
On the shorter side again and on middle, Ackermann makes room and looks to slap it but is done in by the extra bounce. One more dot.
Sees the batter coming down the track so he bowls it short. Ackermann looks to upper cut it but misses.
Back of a length and on off, this is pushed towards point for one.
The physio is out in the middle to check Davey. He seems to be okay. He looks fine but he rushes off the field.

Ouch! That must have hurt! This is on the pads, this is worked towards short fine leg. The fielder there dives to his right, he dives and stops but the ball hits the hand and then deflects onto the face. A single is taken. He looks in a little pain.
Colin Ackermann comes out to bat. Can he play a special knock here to take the Netherlands over the line.

OUT! Caught! Evans strikes! He has not offered any room the batsman. O'Dowd has to create room for himself. This is another ball on middle, O'Dowd looks to power it over the mid on fielder but mistimes the shot. The ball goes straight in the hands of MacLeod.
Length outside off, Cooper this time mistimes his drive through mid off. A quick single as the ball goes towards the mid off fielder.
Shortish length ball on middle, Cooper pulls but can't get the timing right. The ball takes the top edge and lands well ahead of the fielder at deep square leg. A single taken.
Fullish length ball on middle, O'Dowd flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Nicely bowled! Seeing the batsman come down the track, Davey dishes out a full ball outside off O'Dowd reaches out for the drive but misses.
Length ball outside off, tapped towards cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Too straight from Davey. A length ball on the pads, Cooper just guides this angled ball fine down the leg side for a boundary. First of the innings.
Davey starts with a ball on the pads, Cooper looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pad. The ball rolls towards square leg and the batters cross.
Josh Davey comes on to bowl.
Another tight over! Good length ball on off, tapped towards cover-point for a single by O'Dowd.
Length ball on the pads, nudged towards square leg for a single.
Length ball just outside off, O'Dowd guides it towards short third man and takes a single.
Shortish length around off, punched off the back foot by Cooper for a single.
Around off, Cooper this time pushes it towards cover.
On the pads from Evans to start, O'Dowd nudges it behind square for a single.
Alasdair Evans to  start from the other end.
Good length ball on middle, O'Dowd looks to work it down the leg side but gets it towards square leg of the inner half of the willow. A single taken. Superb first over.
Ben Cooper is the new batsman in.

OUT! Visee is out of here! Length ball, closer to the off pole, Visse looks to power it over the long off fence but mistimes the shot. The ball goes high in the air. Davey positions himself under the ball at mid off and pouch it easily. Breakthrough early on for Scotland.
Shortish length ball outside off, punched uppishly through point for a couple.
Around off on a good length, Visse pushes through point.
Play and a miss now! Netherlands need runs thick and fast to finish on top of the group and hence that shot. A length ball around off, Visse looks to loft it over mid off but misses.
Sharif starts with a ball on middle, Visse tucks it towards square leg.

Welcome back for the chase. Scotland players are out in the middle taking their fielding positions. Out walk the two Netherlands' openers Max O'Dowd and Tobias Visee. Safyaan Sharif to start with the ball for Scotland.
